## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
Describe the problem you're trying to solve or the workflow this would improve.

## Proposed Solution
If you have ideas about how to implement this, describe them here.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, code examples, or references here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I am willing to contribute a PR for this feature (optional)
